scope: Corrected four-branch visible tag model, three live paired views. Six Scene and six terrain outputs exact to prior actual12 run. Remaining nine views retained only from prior run, not rerun. GEOS model evidence is not universal original foreground equivalence.

tag.scope: Actual Chrome direct native context original fill/clip/bitmap order plus independent GEOS visible-role clip. Both tag variants omit SS to avoid changed nonlinear eligibility; raw model reports original source-primitive tag losses including hidden AA; visible-oracle model is a bounded GEOS-defined classification and not universal true-foreground preservation or frozen-SS semantic equivalence. Original SS-on vs candidate real RGB/alpha/visual still compared separately.
